title: The State of AI Ethics Report, Volume 5

bias_targets.methodology: Summarizing various empirical studies, including analyzing match scores and preference segregation in collaborative filtering for dating apps, comparing radiology AI performance trained on patient pain feedback versus doctor assessments for Black patients, and auditing Twitter's image cropping algorithm on 10,000 image pairs.
Auditing Twitter's image cropping algorithm on 10,000 image pairs to identify disparities in how the saliency model treats female faces compared to male faces.

Evaluating the performance of a Google dermatology AI application by assessing its accuracy across different Fitzpatrick skin types, specifically noting severe limitations for Type V and Type VI skin tones.
